title: Securitize Counters Anti-Tokenization WSJ Ad With Full-Page Response
why_it_matters: The competing ads expose a practical issuer-education battle: venue-specific third-party tokens, synthetic trackers and regulated security entitlements carry different rights and oversight.
caption:
RWA WIRE // POLICY

Securitize Counters Anti-Tokenization WSJ Ad With Full-Page Response

Securitize answered a nonprofit's Wall Street Journal warning with its own full-page ad promoting one-for-one-backed, regulated tokenized shares.
